title: Yosef Sheida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He lived in the time of Rav Chisda and Rabbah, as in Eruvin 43a (Rashi there explains that he does not keep Shabbat). In Pesachim 110a, Rav Yosef said, “Yosef Sheida told me,” and Rav Papa said, “Yosef Sheida told me.” Hyman infers that he lived a long life.

notes.text: The supplied text joins ליוסף in Rav Papa’s report. Pesachim 110a has אמר לי יוסף שידא, “Yosef Sheida told me,” in both the Rav Yosef and Rav Papa reports. The longevity conclusion is Hyman’s inference.
